title: Basic Hummus
ingredients: 1 50 oz. can of chickpeas or ~90 grams dried and soaked chickpeas
1/4 cup fresh lemon juice (from ~1 large lemon or from concentrate)
2 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil, more to improve consistency
2-3 Tbsp water (if hummus is too thick)
1 Tbsp roasted pine nuts, for garnish
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas in a mixing bowl and coat with the baking soda.
Toss the chickpeas by hand to ensure the baking soda is as evenly coated as possible
Heat on high in the microwave oven or on medium on a skillet until chickpeas are too hot to touch.
Wash in cold water while agitating the beans vigorously with one's hands to release the skin, which should float away relatively easily.
Repeat agitation as many times as needed to skin all the chickpeas (usually 2-3 times).
In an Instant Pot or a pressure cooker, soak the chickpeas until fully submerged and cook for ~12 minutes.
Drain and remove all the skin that has come off the chickpeas while cooking.
Wash in water while agitating the beans with one's hand to ensure all the skin has come off.
Combine the tahini and lemon juice in a food processot and blend until an even cream has formed.
Add the olive oil, garlic, cumin powder and salt. Process for ~30 seconds.
Add the skinned chickpeas and process until thick and smooth.
Add water or olive as necessary to achieve desired consistency.
Top with roasted pine nuts, paprika and an olive oil drizzle before serving
